judge.rationale: The candidate fails to build cleanly because its test calls `startEngineWith({... history: {enabled: true}})` without adding `history` to `startEngineWith`'s parameter type in `src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts` or to `HalEngineConfig` in `src/config.ts`. Worse, the candidate invented the wrong wire protocol names (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `sessions`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionListMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`) instead of the exact names specified in the issue (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `conversations`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationListMessage`, `ConversationSummary`). Validation also violates the acceptance criteria by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of restricting `limit` to 1–200. Finally, several ticket requirements are completely omitted, including threading `transport.history` through `src/config.ts`, updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, updating `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`, implementing `StoreCannotList`, and testing concurrent streaming lock bypass and session resume integration.
